name: HDFC Bank Ltd

business.about: HDFC Bank Limited (also known as HDFC) is an Indian banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai. It is India's largest private sector bank by assets and the world's tenth-largest bank by market capitalization as of May 2024. As of April 2024, HDFC Bank has a market capitalization of $145 billion, making it the third-largest company on the Indian stock exchanges. [1]
business.key_points: Market Position: The company is India's one of the 3 systemically important banks with a 15% market share in the banking sector’s advances and a 37% market share in the private sector banks’ advances as of FY24. It is also the second-largest bank in India . [1] It is among the top 3 Government Banks collecting direct and indirect taxes for the Government of India. [2] It is a market leader in almost every asset category . [3]

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management promised operational profitability would not be impacted in coming quarters.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: OPM remained negative at -17.0% in Q1 FY27 and -6.0% in Q2 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management expected pre-merger style growth levels to return in future quarters.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Sales YoY growth slowed to 0.5% in Q4 FY26 and 3.7% in Q1 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Return on assets continues to be stable despite pressure on NIMs.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Q4 FY26 reported stable return on assets at 1.9%.

bull.point: PAT grew 19.3% YoY in Q1 FY27 and reached ₹21,537 crore in Q2 FY27.
bull.cite: Q1 FY27 pat_yoy and Q2 FY27 pat

bull.point: CFO surged to ₹127,242 crore in FY25 from ₹19,069 crore in FY24.
Return on assets remained stable at 1.9% through FY26.

bear.point: OPM has remained negative from FY24 through Q2 FY27.
bear.cite: FY24 opm and Q2 FY27 opm

bear.point: Annual sales growth collapsed from 66.1% in FY24 to 3.6% in FY26.
Q1 FY27 profit growth of 9.8% lagged overall balance sheet expansion.

verdict: Management has maintained bottom-line stability and ROA, but fails to deliver on promises of positive operating margins and pre-merger revenue growth.
discipline: Primary sources only: company filings via screener.in, earnings-call transcripts. No news, broker notes or model memory.
